purpose: Replicated DNA-protein architecture-family closure after calibrated full-3D RT deprioritization
universe: Frozen Stage05D1 N1+N2 candidates only (expected 602 loci)

family_definition_primary.repeat_core: reverse-complement-canonicalized exact core_nt from high-complexity, full-span-outside-predicted-CDS repeat groups overlapping the mathematical candidate
family_definition_primary.candidate_edge: share >=1 qualifying FAM50 cluster AND >=1 qualifying canonical repeat core

strata.E1A_PRIMARY_REPLICATED_WITH_N1: member of primary replicated component containing >=1 frozen N1 candidate
strata.E1B_PRIMARY_REPLICATED_N2_ONLY: member of primary replicated component containing only frozen N2 candidates
strata.E1C_SENSITIVITY_ONLY_REPLICATED: not primary-replicated but member of sensitivity replicated component
strata.E1D_UNREPLICATED_RETAINED: not in a replicated primary or sensitivity component

claim_boundary: Replicated architecture families are post-discovery organizational units defined from frozen DNA-repeat and nearby-protein-family evidence. They do not establish RT activity, ART identity, transcription, or function.
